_comment: Headline PyO3 API shifts across 0.20-0.31, used by pyo3-version-compat-scanner and lifetime-handle-checker. Seed data: the most-cited migrations. Sourced from https://pyo3.rs/main/migration.html. Each entry's `detect` field tells the scanner how to match it: kind `call` (a call whose leaf name equals `name`), `call_suffix` (a call whose leaf name ends with `name`), `type` (a type identifier whose final segment equals `name`), or `skip` (matched by another agent named in `owner`). Coverage from 0.29 follows the main migration guide, which currently has no separate 0.30 section. `changed_in` records signature, behavior, or build changes for manual review only; it does not trigger scanner classification. `skip` may also designate manual review where syntax alone is insufficient. Version classification: a use is `removed_api` (FIX) at/after `removed`, `deprecated_api` (CONSIDER) at/after `deprecated`, else `renamed_api` (CONSIDER) at/after `renamed_in`.

python_with_gil.note: Legacy GIL-acquire name; scanners recognise both with_gil and attach.

python_allow_threads.note: Legacy GIL-release name; scanners recognise both allow_threads and detach.

python_with_gil_unchecked.note: unsafe variant that skips the interpreter-state check.

gil_once_cell.note: GILOnceCell was renamed to PyOnceLock (true single-init).

py_any_gil_ref.note: GIL-ref type. Kept transitionally behind the `gil-refs` feature; the exact removal release is approximate -- treat presence as CONSIDER on 0.21-0.22, FIX where it no longer compiles.

pydict_gil_ref.note: GIL-ref type; see py_any_gil_ref. The same applies to &PyList, &PyTuple, &PyString, &PyBytes, etc.

py_as_ref.note: Py::as_ref(py) returned a GIL ref; use Py::bind(py) -> &Bound<'py, T>.

py_clone.note: Bare Clone on Py<T> was deprecated in 0.21 and gated behind the opt-in `py-clone` feature in 0.22 (it panics without the GIL). Prefer .clone_ref(py).

bound_suffix.note: 0.21 added `_bound`-suffixed constructors (PyString::new_bound, ...). 0.23 dropped the suffix. NOT auto-detected: the `_bound` suffix collides with the current `Py::into_bound` method and the stdlib `lower_bound`/`upper_bound`, so a suffix match is almost all false positives. Grep `_bound(` and review by hand on a 0.21-0.22 crate.

into_py_trait.note: IntoPy and ToPyObject were replaced by the IntoPyObject trait in 0.23.

pycell.note: PyCell<T> was deprecated in favour of Bound<'py, T> and Py<T>.

py_from_owned_ptr.note: Py<T>::from_owned_ptr was deprecated in 0.28; Bound::from_owned_ptr is the replacement (same leaf method name; the receiver field disambiguates).

detect.owner: manual review (requires type or build configuration context)

pyerr_from_utf8_error.note: Only the implicit conversion was removed; Utf8Error itself remains valid. Review ? and .into() conversions to PyErr and retain the input bytes.

detect.owner: manual review (requires type or build configuration context)

pyerr_from_utf16_error.note: Construct the Python decoding exception explicitly with the required source and error details; the Rust error alone is insufficient. Do not flag unrelated uses of this error type.

detect.owner: manual review (requires type or build configuration context)

pyerr_from_decode_utf16_error.note: Construct the Python decoding exception explicitly with the required source and error details; the Rust error alone is insufficient. Do not flag unrelated uses of this error type.

pyerr_owned_unicode_error_conversions.replacement: Retain the conversions; update expectations for the Python exception class

detect.owner: manual review (requires type or build configuration context)

pyerr_owned_unicode_error_conversions.note: These two implementations were corrected, not removed. Review exception-class assertions and handlers.

pyo3_build_config_direct_dependency.replacement: Add a direct dependency on pyo3 or pyo3-ffi

detect.owner: manual review (requires type or build configuration context)

pyo3_build_config_direct_dependency.note: Configuration now comes from pyo3-ffi's build script. Review the calling crate's Cargo.toml, especially cross-compilation setups; build-config usage alone is not an error.

pyclass_tuple_superclass_initializer.rust_signature_pattern: #[new] returning (Sub, Base) / From<(S, B)> for PyClassInitializer<S>

detect.owner: manual review (requires type or build configuration context)

pyclass_tuple_superclass_initializer.note: Use an explicit initializer. Tuple conversion also requires review where no compiler warning is emitted. No removal release is specified.

detect.owner: manual review (requires type or build configuration context)

pycapsule_destructor_static.note: Review borrowed captures; the new lifetime bound prevents a destructor outliving its captured data. The constructor remains available.

detect.owner: manual review (requires type or build configuration context)

pycfunction_closure_sync.note: Review captured state for thread-safe shared access. The constructor remains available; do not treat every call as removed.

pyclass_guard_map_mut.replacement: PyClassGuardMap for shared mappings; PyClassGuardMapMut for mutable mappings

detect.owner: manual review (requires type or build configuration context)

pyclass_guard_map_mut.note: Update mutable mapping annotations for the split guard types. Shared PyClassGuardMap uses remain valid.

detect.owner: manual review (requires type or build configuration context)

pyclass_guard_mut_as_super.note: The return type replaces &mut PyClassGuardMut<SuperType>; adjust annotations and callers relying on the old reference type.

critical_section_mutex2_optional_guard.replacement: Handle Option<EnteredCriticalSection> in the callback's second argument

detect.owner: manual review (requires type or build configuration context)

critical_section_mutex2_optional_guard.note: The optional second guard handles both arguments naming the same mutex without creating aliased mutable references.

windows_generate_import_lib_noop.replacement: Remove reliance on generate-import-lib; Windows builds use raw-dylib linking

detect.owner: manual review (requires type or build configuration context)

windows_generate_import_lib_noop.note: The feature remains accepted but has no effect. Import libraries are no longer needed for Windows targets.

pybuffer_as_slice.note: Copy through an owned Rust buffer. Alternatively use as_slice_ptr with independently justified aliasing guarantees before creating references. Detection covers qualified PyBuffer calls only; review buffer.as_slice(...) manually because the scanner cannot resolve receiver types. No deprecation version is inferred.
